artifact_sha256_note: Corrected 2026-08-19 from f110758c... to f0177891.... These are the same artifact, not two models: mlb_challenger_store.py hashes the file's raw bytes, and with core.autocrlf=true and no .gitattributes, a Windows checkout rendered mlb_run_strength_model_v1.json with CRLF (f110758c...) while the committed blob and every Linux CI checkout kept LF (f0177891...). The frozen value had been captured on a Windows checkout, so exact_cohort_required could never be satisfied by a CI-produced lock and this gate was accumulating evidence it would have had to reject. The corrected value is the one all 30 shadow locks in mlb_shadow_ledger.jsonl already recorded, so the collected evidence is preserved rather than discarded. .gitattributes now pins eol=lf so the hash is platform-stable; test_mlb_model_promotion.py asserts the artifact on disk still hashes to this value.
